entry.title: Natalie Portman Revisits Her Most Iconic Fashion Moments | Fashion Flashback | Harper’s BAZAAR

media:group.media:title: Natalie Portman Revisits Her Most Iconic Fashion Moments | Fashion Flashback | Harper’s BAZAAR
media:group.media:description:
Natalie Portman has spent decades making memorable fashion moments on and off the red carpet. In this episode of “Fashion Flashback,” the Academy Award-winning actress and Harper’s BAZAAR cover star looks back at some of her most iconic looks, from the Betsey Johnson dress and faux-fur jacket she wore to the ‘Léon’ premiere at 13 to the Lanvin gown Albert Elbaz made for her first Oscars. She also reflects on her most memorable Golden Globes and Cannes looks, the dresses she’s been able to keep from her red carpet archive, and the challenges of wearing couture on the red carpet.
Read Natalie Portman’s Harper’s BAZAAR cover story here: http://harpersbazaar.com/natalie-portman-november-2026
